S3-T.basis: 6x6 RTN second moment about zero of SGP4 errors against truth (km, km/s), clipped at 5 robust sigma per position component

S3-TU.basis: 6x6 RTN second moment about zero of SGP4 errors against truth (km, km/s)

S3-KC.basis: 6x6 RTN second moment about zero of SGP4 errors against truth (km, km/s), clipped at 5 robust sigma per position component; times the factor that puts the dev-fit 95 % coverage at 0.95 (gp-error-model fit_calibration, coverage)

S3-KO.rule: objectFactor = (n mean(d' S(g)^-1 d / 3) + 8) / (n + 8) over the object's consecutive differences created in the 30 days before the set (at least 2), times S3-KC
